title: QI·46 Corpus Tagging Schema
description: Per docs/corporate/LOT_QI46_ENGINE.md, Section IV, Step 0.2. Applied to every document before it enters the training corpus.

arc_position.description: n/a for corpus documents that are not subscriber-arc-scoped (white papers, brand copy, vision docs).

cosmo_cleared.description: true only after a human (S-2) has reviewed the document for inclusion. This build sets cosmo_cleared: false on every record it emits — no document in this corpus has been through a human COSMO® review pass yet. Flip to true per-document only after that review happens.
